cards.ex: He always wears his heart on his sleeve, so everyone knows when he's upset.
cards.exUz: U doim yuragidagini aytadi, shuning uchun hamma uning xafa ekanligini biladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini ochiqchasiga, hech narsani yashirmasdan namoyon qilish.

cards.ex: She was beside herself with worry when her son didn't come home.
cards.exUz: O'g'li uyga kelmaganida u xavotirlanib o'zini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli hissiyotdan o'zini tuta olmaslik, hayajondan aqlini yo'qotish.

cards.ex: I tried to keep a lid on my anger, but it was difficult.
cards.exUz: Men g'azabimni bostirishga harakat qildim, lekin bu qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlarni, ayniqsa g'azabni, tashqariga chiqarmaslikka harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He tends to bury his feelings instead of talking about them.
cards.exUz: U his-tuyg'ularini gapirish o'rniga yashirishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlarni ichga yashirish, ularni ko'rsatmaslikka harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He had to swallow his pride and ask for help.
cards.exUz: U g'ururini yengib, yordam so'rashga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: G'ururiga qarshi borish, biror narsa qilish uchun o'zini majburlash.

cards.ex: She has a soft spot for stray animals and always tries to help them.
cards.exUz: Uning daydi hayvonlarga mehri tushgan va u doim ularga yordam berishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir alohida mehr va sevgi bilan qarash.

cards.ex: I always get butterflies in my stomach before a presentation.
cards.exUz: Men har doim taqdimotdan oldin hayajonlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir oldin asabiylashish, ichida qandaydir g'alati his paydo bo'lish.

cards.ex: I saw red when I found out what he had done.
cards.exUz: Men uning nima qilganini bilganimda g'azablandim.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablanish, qattiq jahli chiqish, o'zini tuta olmaslik.

cards.ex: She was on cloud nine after getting the job.
cards.exUz: U ishga kirganidan so'ng baxtdan yettinchi osmonda edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baxtli bo'lish, shodlikdan hamma narsani unutish.

cards.ex: I get a real kick out of helping people.
cards.exUz: Men odamlarga yordam berishdan juda huzurlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir katta lazzat olish, quvonmoq, xursand bo'lish.

cards.ex: Stop wallowing in self-pity and do something about it!
cards.exUz: O'zingga rahm qilishni bas qil va biror narsa qil!
cards.uzDef: O'z holatidan nolish, o'zini ayblash va o'ziga achinish.

cards.ex: I'm at my wit's end trying to figure out this problem.
cards.exUz: Men bu muammoni hal qilishga urinib boshim qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Qanday yordam berishni bilmaslik, muammoni hal qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: She has a heart of gold and is always helping others.
cards.exUz: Uning oltin yuragi bor va har doim boshqalarga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Juda mehribon, saxiy va yaxshi inson bo'lish.

cards.ex: I've been feeling down all week.
cards.exUz: Men butun hafta davomida tushkunlikda yuribman.
cards.uzDef: Kayfiyati yo'q, xafa bo'lish, tushkun holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: She was in good spirits despite the bad news.
cards.exUz: U yomon xabarga qaramay xush kayfiyatda edi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi kayfiyatda bo'lish, xursand va quvnoq bo'lish.

cards.ex: I was a bundle of nerves before the interview.
cards.exUz: Men intervyudan oldin juda asabiy edim.
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiy, xavotirda, hayajonda bo'lish.

cards.ex: His constant complaining really gets under my skin.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari meni juda jahldan chiqaradi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir g'azablantirish, asabiga tegish, jahldan chiqarish.

cards.ex: She was torn apart by the loss of her friend.
cards.exUz: U do'stining yo'qotilishidan qattiq azob chekdi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq xafa bo'lish, azob chekish, ruhiy jihatdan og'ir ahvolda bo'lish.

cards.ex: He had a face like thunder when he found out.
cards.exUz: U bilib olganida qovog'i solingan edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablangan, qovoq solgan, xafa holda bo'lish.

cards.ex: We were on tenterhooks waiting for the exam results.
cards.exUz: Biz imtihon natijalarini xavotir bilan kutdik.
cards.uzDef: Xavotir bilan kutish, noaniqlikdan asabiylashish.

cards.ex: She's been in the dumps since she lost her job.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shatilganidan beri tushkunlikda.
cards.uzDef: Kayfiyati yo'q, xafa, tushkun holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The kids were bouncing off the walls after the party.
cards.exUz: Bolalar ziyofatdan keyin harakatdan to'xtamadilar.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand, hayajonda, energiya bilan to'lib toshgan bo'lish.

cards.ex: Lighten up! It's not the end of the world.
cards.exUz: Yengillashing! Bu dunyoning oxiri emas.
cards.uzDef: Xotirjam bo'lish, stressni kamaytirish, kamroq jiddiy bo'lish.

cards.ex: He took my advice to heart and made some changes.
cards.exUz: U mening maslahatimni yaqin oldi va o'zgarishlar qildi.
cards.uzDef: Maslahatni, tanqidni jiddiy qabul qilish, e'tiborga olish.

cards.ex: The community was up in arms about the new development.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat yangi qurilish haqida g'azabda edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir norozi bo'lish, g'azablanish va qarshilik ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: He finally let rip at his boss after months of frustration.
cards.exUz: U oxir-oqibat bir necha oy davom etgan umidsizlikdan so'ng boshlig'iga qarshi chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlarni, ayniqsa g'azabni ochiqchasiga namoyon qilish.

cards.ex: I had a lump in my throat when I said goodbye.
cards.exUz: Men xayrlashganimda tomog'imga tiqilib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotdan, ko'pincha qayg'udan gapirish qiyin bo'lish.

cards.ex: Keep your chin up! Things will get better.
cards.exUz: Ruhdan tushmang! Hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, umidvor bo'lish, ruhdan tushmaslik.

cards.ex: Her face was brimming with joy when she saw her family.
cards.exUz: U oilasini ko'rganida yuzidan shodlik yog'ilib turardi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand bo'lish, yuzidan shodlik yog'ilib turish.

cards.ex: She choked back tears as she told the story.
cards.exUz: U hikoyani aytib berar ekan, yig'ini bostirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yig'lamaslikka harakat qilish, ko'z yoshlarini ushlab turish.
